Extracting the final dose for each simulation and calculate the error to true ID70
```{r}
final_results <- opt_results %>%
  group_by(design_id, sim_id) %>%
  arrange(cohort, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    final_log10_dose = log10(current_dose)
  )

true_prior <- read.csv("simulation result/expected_info_2/true_priors.csv")

# True beta-Poisson infection probability
true_infection_prob <- function(dose, log10_id70, a) {

  id70 <- 10^log10_id70

  b <- id70 / (0.3^(-1 / a) - 1)

  1 - (1 + dose / b)^(-a)
}



final_results <- final_results %>% 
  left_join(true_prior, by = "sim_id") %>%
  mutate(
    dose_error =
      final_log10_dose - true_log10_id70,

    abs_dose_error =
      abs(dose_error),

    squared_dose_error =
      dose_error^2,
    
    true_prob_selected = true_infection_prob(
      dose = current_dose,
      log10_id70 = true_log10_id70,
      a = true_a
    ),

    correct_target_selection =
      true_prob_selected >= 0.6 &
      true_prob_selected <= 0.8
  ) 
    
```  


```{r}
design_performance <- final_results %>%
  group_by(design_id) %>%
  summarise(

    # accuracy
    mean_abs_error = mean(abs_dose_error, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    mae_lower = quantile(abs_dose_error, 0.025),
    
    mae_upper = quantile(abs_dose_error, 0.975),

    median_abs_error = median(abs_dose_error, na.rm = TRUE),

    rmse = sqrt(mean(dose_error^2, na.rm = TRUE)),

    # directional bias
    mean_bias = mean(dose_error, na.rm = TRUE),

    # final information
    mean_cumulative_utility = mean(current_expected_utility, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    cumulative_utility_lower = quantile(current_expected_utility, 0.025),
    
    cumulative_utility_upper = quantile(current_expected_utility, 0.975),
    
    target_selection_rate = mean(correct_target_selection),
    
    selection_rate_lower = quantile(true_prob_selected, 0.025),
    
    selection_rate_upper = quantile(true_prob_selected, 0.975),

    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

Exploring if the final selected dose's posterior probability of infection falls between target infection range of 60 - 80%
```{r}
rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE)

crm_stan2 <- stan_model("code/CRM stan.stan")

doses <- 10^(3:7)

extract_final_posterior <- function(trial_path) {
  
  final_dose <- trial_path %>%
  arrange(cohort) %>%
  slice_tail(n=1) %>%
  pull(current_dose)

  final_idx <- match(final_dose, doses)
  
  counts <- trial_path %>%
    group_by(current_dose) %>%
    summarise(
      n = sum(cohort_size),
      y = sum(infected),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  n <- numeric(length(doses))
  y <- numeric(length(doses))
  
  idx <- match(counts$current_dose, doses)
  
  n[idx] <- counts$n
  y[idx] <- counts$y
  
  fit <- rstan::sampling(
        crm_stan2,
        data = list(
          K = length(doses),
          dose = doses,
          n = n,
          y = y
        ),
        chains = 4,
        iter = 2000,
        warmup = 1000,
        refresh = 0,
        cores = 1
      )
  
  selected_dose_post_draw <- rstan::extract(fit)$p[, final_idx]
  
  data.frame(
    final_dose = final_dose,
    
    posterior_target_prob = mean(selected_dose_post_draw >= 0.6 & selected_dose_post_draw <= 0.8),
    
    posterior_prob_mean <- mean(selected_dose_post_draw),
    
    posterior_prob_lower <- quantile(selected_dose_post_draw, 0.025),
    
    posterior_prob_upper <- quantile(selected_dose_post_draw, 0.975)
  )
}


final_post_results <- opt_results %>%
  group_by(design_id, sim_id) %>%
  group_modify(~ extract_final_posterior(.x)) %>%
  ungroup()


write.csv(final_post_results, "simulation result/expected_info_2/final posterior prob inf.csv", row.names = FALSE)

final_post_results <- read.csv("simulation result/expected_info_2/final posterior prob inf.csv")
```


```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=8}
final_post_results <- final_post_results %>%
  mutate(
    coverage = case_when(
      posterior_prob_lower....quantile.selected_dose_post_draw..0.025. <= 0.8 & 
        posterior_prob_upper....quantile.selected_dose_post_draw..0.975. >= 0.6 ~ "Overlapped",
      
      posterior_prob_lower....quantile.selected_dose_post_draw..0.025. >= 0.6 & 
        posterior_prob_upper....quantile.selected_dose_post_draw..0.975. <= 0.8 ~ "Entirely within",
      
      TRUE ~ "Not Covered"
      
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(design_id) %>%
  arrange(posterior_prob_mean....mean.selected_dose_post_draw., .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(sim_order = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()


p <- ggplot(final_post_results, aes(x = sim_order, ymin = posterior_prob_lower....quantile.selected_dose_post_draw..0.025., ymax = posterior_prob_upper....quantile.selected_dose_post_draw..0.975., colour = coverage)) +
  
  geom_linerange(linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.4) +
  
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = c(0.60, 0.80),
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(~design_id, ncol=2, labeller = labeller(design_id = function(x) paste("Design", x))) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Entirely within" = "#228B22",
                                 "Overlapped" = "#3182BD",
                                 "Not Covered" = "#E31A1C")) +
  
  guides(
  colour = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(
      linewidth = 2,
      alpha = 1
      )
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1), breaks = seq(0,1,0.2)) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Simulation (ordered by posterior mean infection probability)",
    y = "Posterior infection probability at final cohort dose",
    colour = "95% credible interval"
  ) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    # X and Y axis titles
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
  
    # X and Y axis tick labels
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
  
    # Legend title and labels
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 15),
  )

ggsave("plots/final_dose_posterior_prob_per_design.pdf", p,
       width = 14, height = 14)
```

Trimming the results since we run all trials in full length (WE DONT TRIM NOW)

```{r}
trimmed_results <- opt_results %>%
  arrange(design_id, sim_id, cohort) %>%
  group_by(design_id, sim_id) %>%
  
  # cumulative number treated at each dose
  mutate(
    cumulative_n_at_dose = ave(cohort_size, current_dose, FUN = cumsum)
  ) %>%
  # first cohort where current dose reaches/exceeds 20 participants
  mutate(
    stop_cohort = ifelse(
      any(cumulative_n_at_dose >= 20),
      min(cohort[cumulative_n_at_dose >= 20]),
      Inf)
  ) %>%
  # keep everything up to and including stopping cohort
  filter(
    cohort <= stop_cohort
  ) %>%
  
  ungroup()
  
```

```{r}
utility_plot_trimmed_data <- trimmed_results %>%

ggplot(utility_plot_trimmed_data, aes(x = cohort, y = mean_cumulative_expected_utility, group = factor(design_id), colour = factor(design_id))) +
```

```{r}
  arrange(cohort, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    final_log10_dose = log10(current_dose)
  ) %>% 
  left_join(true_prior, by = "sim_id") %>%
  mutate(
    dose_error =
      final_log10_dose - true_log10_id70,

    abs_dose_error =
      abs(dose_error),

    squared_dose_error =
      dose_error^2
  ) %>%
  select(
    design_id,
    sim_id,
    full_N = total_enrolled,
    full_abs_error = abs_dose_error
  )

trimmed_final <- trimmed_final_results %>%
  select(
    design_id,
    sim_id,
    trimmed_N = total_enrolled,
    trimmed_abs_error = abs_dose_error
  )

trim_comparison <- trimmed_final %>%
  left_join(
    full_final,
    by = c(
      "design_id",
      "sim_id"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    participants_saved =
      full_N - trimmed_N,

    change_in_abs_error =
      trimmed_abs_error - full_abs_error
  )
```

```{r}
trim_comparison %>%
  group_by(design_id) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_N_trimmed = mean(trimmed_N),
    mean_N_full = mean(full_N),

    mean_saved = mean(participants_saved),

    mean_AE_trimmed = mean(trimmed_abs_error),
    mean_AE_full = mean(full_abs_error),

    mean_change_AE = mean(change_in_abs_error),

    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


```{r}
# all possible combinations of cohort structure
n_grid <- expand.grid(
  replicate(7, c(5,10), simplify = FALSE)
)

names(n_grid) <- paste0("n", 1:7)

n_grid <- n_grid %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  filter(
    !is.unsorted(c_across(n1:n7)) # check if the row is sorted in ascending order
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

for (i in 1:nrow(n_grid)) {
  
  count = 0 
  max_sample = 35
  
  for (j in 1:ncol(n_grid)) {
    count = count + n_grid[i, j]
    
    if (count > max_sample) {
      n_grid[i, j] = NA
    }
  }
}


design_matrix <- n_grid

design_matrix
```
